title: 动名词作宾语

examples.en: Have you finished doing your homework?

guess.question: enjoy、finish 后面的动词为什么要加 -ing？

options.text: 这两个词后面只接 doing，不接 to do
options.feedback: 对！这是固定搭配，没有为什么，只能记住哪些动词“只跟 doing”。
不对——finished doing 说的是已经做完，并不是正在进行。
不对——时态和它无关，过去时也一样说 He enjoyed reading。

rule.rule: enjoy / finish / practice / mind / keep / suggest / miss / give up 等后面接 doing
rule.formula: 动词 + doing　（这些词后面不能接 to do）

anchors.en: He finished doing his homework at nine.

trap.wrong: I enjoy to read English stories.
trap.why: enjoy 后面只能接 doing，接 to do 是错的。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——这批词（enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep）后面一律 doing，看见它们就别想 to do。

check.stem: She enjoys ____ (listen) to music after school.

options.distractor: enjoy 后面不接 to do
finish 后面不接 to do

options.text: We practice speaking English every morning.
We practice to speak English every morning.
options.distractor: practice 后面不接 to do

options.text: We practice speak English every morning.
We practice spoke English every morning.
